issues.detail: The Hebrew 'וַתְּהִי הַתְּשֻׁעָה' means 'the victory/salvation was' (i.e., the victory became mourning), but the Vietnamese renders 'niềm vui' ('joy'), which is not in the Hebrew text. The Hebrew word 'תְּשׁוּעָה' means 'victory/deliverance', not 'joy'. This changes the meaning of the verse.
